title: Why don't I qualify for Silver Account benefits?
summary: Explains why customers may not qualify for Silver Account benefits: balance under $1,000 can trigger the monthly maintenance fee and loss of perks, and balance below $10,000 prevents earning the higher APY tier. It advises checking outgoing transfers/withdrawals and pending transactions/holds, then restoring balances and setting balance alerts.
